Stability troubleshooting

Feature: Stability troubleshooting (frankea/Whisky#40) Last updated: 13 January 2026

This document is a contributor-facing procedure for triaging critical stability issues: crashes, hard freezes, reboots and kernel panics.

Applicability

Use this guide for reports of:

  • a macOS kernel panic or reboot during game launch or gameplay;
  • a complete system freeze requiring a forced reboot;
  • a Gmac UI freeze, for example while opening bottle configuration;
  • a Gmac crash on launch or during GmacWine installation.

Immediate mitigations for users

  • Enable Sequoia Compatibility Mode (Bottle → Config → Metal → "Sequoia Compatibility Mode"). This addresses several macOS 15.x behaviours.
  • Disable DXR. Ray tracing stresses graphics paths on some systems.
  • Kill All Bottles (menu item). Terminates Wine processes for all bottles; use it when those processes are unresponsive or the UI is frozen.

Collecting diagnostics

A complete report is required for actionable triage.

Stability diagnostics report

If the build includes the stability diagnostics control (see frankea/Whisky#56), collect this report first:

  1. Open the affected bottle.
  2. Open Config.
  3. If a Stability section is present, select Generate Stability Diagnostics.
  4. Export the report to a file and attach it to the issue.

If the section is absent, skip this step and attach Wine logs instead.

Notes:

  • The stability report is bounded, so it is safe to share.
  • It includes environment keys only, without values, to reduce privacy risk.

Wine log folder

In the application, select Open Logs Folder (menu item) and attach the newest .log files if requested.

Gmac enforces log size limits, comprising a per-file cap and a folder cap, to prevent excessive disk use.

macOS crash and panic logs

For kernel panics and reboots:

  • Collect the panic report from Console.app (System Reports, Panic reports).
  • Include the exact error string if one is visible, for example IOMFB int_handler_gated: failure: axi_rd_err.

Minimal reproduction template

Include the following in the issue:

  • Mac model (for example, M3 Max)
  • macOS version (for example, 15.2 or 15.4.1)
  • Gmac version and GmacWine version
  • Game or application and its distribution channel (Steam, GOG and so on)
  • Bottle settings: Sequoia compatibility, DXVK, DXR, Enhanced Sync
  • Steps to reproduce, reduced to the shortest reliable sequence
  • Expected and actual behaviour
  • The stability diagnostics report if available, plus any relevant logs

Triage guidance for maintainers

  • If the report indicates a UI freeze correlated with Wine commands, investigate main-thread starvation and long-running aggregation of Wine commands first.
  • If the report indicates a kernel panic, treat it as likely to be at driver level. Focus on mitigations (DXR disabled, a different graphics backend) and on collecting high-quality reproduction data.
  • If the report indicates a GmacWine installation failure, collect the exact error message, validate the tarball structure and the version plist, and attach the relevant logs.
